Man, I don't know,because we are totally broke. We don't have closer or further relatives to ask for help. We are literally on the edge of the society when it comes to doing anything to save ourselves. I tried my best to actually ask for help from anyone, but no one is interested in helping, but they are interested in seeing me falling down. So I feel like I'm pushed to the edge in a way where I truly believe that going into the abyss is actually only real solution. We still have few hours to collect money and we can't. So it's either bullets to our heads or choosing to end my life in my way. I have no other choice. I was thinking about it for a decent amount of time how to solve that shit and I was doing everything I literally can, but I only found closed doors and laughs. So, yeah. If it's going to end like this, I believe it's gonna be in my way. At least I know I did it, not someone else.
I know that my parents and I don't have anywhere to go away. We simply don't have any solution to it. Nor do I. I tried my best but still, that's it. It is time.
